gloss: to do ~ over again; to redo ~

definitions.gloss: to do ~ over again; to redo ~
definitions.explanation: Attaches to the masu-stem of a verb to indicate repeating an action from the beginning, usually to correct or improve the result. The resulting compound conjugates as a godan verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧⟦やり{直|なお}そう→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧。
⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{書|か}き{直|なお}して→書き直す：04597_kakinaosu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: There was a mistake, so please rewrite it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いかなかった⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{考|かんが}え{直|なお}す⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The plan didn't work out, so we need to rethink it from scratch.

notes:
FORMS:
Attaches to the masu-stem (⟦{連用形|れんようけい}→連用形：16646_renyoukei⟧) of verbs:
- ⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ → ⟦やり→やる：02980_yaru⟧ + {直|なお}す → やり{直|なお}す
- ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ → ⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧ + {直|なお}す → {書|か}き{直|なお}す
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ → ⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧ + {直|なお}す → {見|み}{直|なお}す

The compound conjugates as a godan verb ({直|なお}す).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- やり{直|なお}す (to redo)
- {書|か}き{直|なお}す (to rewrite)
- {見|み}{直|なお}す (to review; to reconsider)
- {作|つく}り{直|なお}す (to remake)
- {出|で}{直|なお}す (to start over from the beginning)
- {考|かんが}え{直|なお}す (to reconsider)

USAGE:
Implies that the first attempt was unsatisfactory or needs improvement. Unlike simply repeating an action (⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧), ～{直|なお}す carries the nuance of correcting or doing better the second time around.
